hooks.name: Product Registration
hooks.description: Validates form fields, uploads image to Cloudinary, and stores product data when a supplier submits the product registration form
hooks.prompt:
Process the product registration form by performing these actions:
1. Validate all form fields
2. Upload the product image to Cloudinary
3. Store the product data in the database
4. Redirect to product listing page
5. Display success toast notification

hooks.name: Reseller Registration
hooks.description: Creates a reseller in the database and associates them with the current supplier
hooks.prompt:
Process the reseller registration by:
1. Creating the reseller in the database with the provided name and email
2. Associate the new reseller with the current supplier
3. Return confirmation of successful registration

hooks.name: Quote Request
hooks.description: Creates a quote request in the system and optionally notifies the supplier
hooks.prompt:
Process the quote request by:
1. Creating a request record in the system with the selected products
2. Sending a notification to the supplier (if enabled)
3. Confirm the request has been submitted successfully
